safety & hosts

we want you to feel safe here, and your kids too. here's who gets to speak in this house.

inside the app

there are no strangers on infinite hill. you can send a lantern — a link to a friend — or join a circle with a code from someone you know: a teacher, a temple, a church, a mosque, a synagogue, a gurdwara, a family. a circle sees how many are in it, how many walked today, and the nicknames of people who chose to show one. no feed, no followers, no messages from strangers.

the guide and the companion

the guide and the companion are AI — claude, made by anthropic. they answer from your door's lessons (and from any tradition's own texts, if you ask about it), and they can talk with you about your day. they remember only what you tap to keep, and they never connect you with strangers.

kids

nothing on infinite hill is written to target an age, and younger kids come in through a parent's table, not alone. parents see what the table sees. we don't sell a young person's faith to anyone — see Privacy.

off the app

golden hour nights aren't running yet. when they come, they'll be hosted only by institutions and organizers we've checked — a real place, a real record, a real person responsible for the room. every event will be 18+. reporting a host from the app is coming with them; a reported host will be paused until we've looked.

if you're struggling

if things are heavy right now, please talk to someone: a friend, a clergy member, a doctor. you don't have to carry it alone. infinite hill is a daily practice, not care. if you write something that sounds like you're in danger, the app shows you 988 and other ways to reach a person. the path will be right where you left it, whenever you're ready.
